set_up.summary: The project can be started using Docker Compose configurations for development, local, staging, and production environments, or via Makefile targets and manual Python-based execution, with Docker Compose being the most reliable method.

env_vars.name: ENVIRONMENT
env_vars.purpose: Determines configuration behavior (DEVELOPMENT, STAGING, PRODUCTION); used in entrypoint.sh and gunicorn.conf.py to set log levels and settings.

env_vars.name: POSTGRES_USER
env_vars.purpose: PostgreSQL username for database access; defined in docker-compose files and loaded from .env.

env_vars.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env_vars.purpose: PostgreSQL password for database authentication; defined in docker-compose files and loaded from .env.

env_vars.name: POSTGRES_DB
env_vars.purpose: PostgreSQL database name; defined in docker-compose files and loaded from .env.

env_vars.name: REDIS_PORT
env_vars.purpose: Port to bind Redis to on the host; defaults to 6379, used in docker-compose.yml and derived files.

env_vars.name: PORT
env_vars.purpose: API service port; defaults to 8000, used in entrypoint.sh and overrides in compose files.

env_vars.name: HOST
env_vars.purpose: API bind host; defaults to 0.0.0.0, used in entrypoint.sh and compose command overrides.

env_vars.name: LOG_LEVEL
env_vars.purpose: Logging verbosity level; auto-set by ENVIRONMENT in entrypoint.sh but can be overridden.

env_vars.name: WORKERS
env_vars.purpose: Number of Gunicorn worker processes; defaults to CPU count in gunicorn.conf.py and can be overridden.

files_guide.purpose: Development configuration for the API (uvicorn --reload), Celery worker, and beat scheduler with mounted source code volumes; uses docker/Dockerfile with 'development' target.
Local development setup that mounts the entire project root into containers; uses docker/Dockerfile (development target) and workers/Dockerfile; named 'ramp-' prefixed services.

Staging environment configuration, similar to dev.yml but uses environment variables from .env files and includes health checks with interpolated $POSTGRES_USER/$POSTGRES_DB; uses docker/Dockerfile with 'development' target.
Production configuration using 'production' stage of docker/Dockerfile; runs Gunicorn via UvicornWorker (no reload), with concurrency set; uses celery-worker-main with --concurrency=4.
Multi-stage Dockerfile with base, dependencies, development, and production stages: development for hot reload (mounting src), production for final optimized image with minimal runtime.
Dockerfile specifically for Celery worker and beat services; uses Python 3.11-slim-bookworm, installs poetry, and runs Celery with fixed queue configuration.
Task runner for local development: installs dependencies, runs migrations, starts server, runs tests, and lints code using Poetry-managed Python environment.
Validation script to ensure Docker, Node.js (via nvm), Python 3.11+, and AWS CLI are installed and configured for deployment readiness.
Gunicorn configuration file that defines bind, workers, logging, and lifecycle hooks; used in production stage of docker/Dockerfile and invoked by entrypoint.sh.
Main Nginx configuration for reverse proxy, Gzip compression, security headers, and rate limiting; includes conf.d/*.conf.
Nginx site-specific configuration for routing traffic to upstream services (api-main, dashboard, display); handles HTTPS redirection and Let's Encrypt challenges.

run_options.name: Docker Compose (all services)
run_options.best_for: Standard development, staging, or production environments where consistent, isolated, and reproducible setups are required.

steps.title: Install Docker and Docker Compose
steps.description: Ensure Docker and docker-compose are installed and running.

steps.title: Prepare environment variables
steps.description: Create a .env file in the root or apps/api-main/ directory with required variables like POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, POSTGRES_DB, REDIS_PORT.
steps.command: cp .env.example .env || echo "Create .env file with required variables from docker-compose files"

steps.title: Build and start development environment
steps.description: Start the development environment with auto-reload enabled using docker-compose.dev.yml.

steps.title: Start local development environment
steps.description: Start the local environment with source code mounted from project root using docker-compose.local.yml.

steps.title: Start staging environment
steps.description: Start the staging environment with production-like variables but development build target.

steps.title: Start production environment
steps.description: Build and start the production environment using the production Dockerfile stage and production configuration.

steps.title: Verify services
steps.description: Check if API, Redis, and PostgreSQL are healthy using curl or by checking logs.

run_options.name: Makefile-based local setup
run_options.best_for: Quick local development without containers, when Python 3.11+ and PostgreSQL are already installed.

steps.title: Install dependencies using Poetry
steps.description: Install project dependencies (including dev) using Poetry, as defined in pyproject.toml.

steps.title: Apply database migrations
steps.description: Run Alembic migrations to initialize or update the PostgreSQL schema.

steps.title: Start FastAPI API server
steps.description: Start the API using Uvicorn in development mode with auto-reload enabled.

steps.title: Start Celery worker
steps.description: Start the Celery worker process in a separate terminal using the same dependencies.
steps.command: poetry run celery -A src.core.celery_app:app worker -l INFO

steps.title: Start Celery beat scheduler
steps.description: Start the Celery beat scheduler to trigger periodic tasks.
steps.command: poetry run celery -A src.core.celery_app:app beat -l INFO

steps.title: Verify API endpoint
steps.description: Test the running API by accessing a basic endpoint like /health.

run_options.name: Manual local setup with Poetry and standalone services
run_options.best_for: Debugging or experimental changes when you want complete control over each service and package version.

steps.title: Install Poetry if not present
steps.description: Ensure Poetry is installed to manage Python dependencies.

steps.title: Install project dependencies
steps.description: Install all dependencies (core + dev) using Poetry in the project root.

steps.title: Start PostgreSQL service manually
steps.description: Manually launch PostgreSQL server on localhost:5432 with user/password/dbname matching .env.

steps.title: Start Redis service manually
steps.description: Launch Redis server on localhost:6379.

steps.title: Initialize database schema
steps.description: Apply Alembic migrations to the local PostgreSQL database.

steps.title: Start API server manually
steps.description: Start the FastAPI application using Uvicorn with reload and debug options.

steps.title: Start Celery worker manually
steps.description: Manually invoke the Celery worker with specified queues.
steps.command: poetry run celery -A src.core.celery_app:app worker --queues=s3-events,default,celery -l INFO

steps.title: Start Celery beat manually
steps.description: Manually invoke the Celery beat scheduler.
steps.command: poetry run celery -A src.core.celery_app:app beat -l INFO

steps.title: Verify services availability
steps.description: Check that the services respond via HTTP and that database and Redis connections are valid.
steps.command: curl http://localhost:8000/health && redis-cli ping && psql -U user -d dbname -c "SELECT 1;"
